decision: No penalty is imposed. No further action required.
event_name: Document 8 Date 02 August 2019 Time 13:23 2019 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 1 - 4 August 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 6) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Stopping in the fast lane, contrary to the Race Director's instruction (Document 2, item 7.2).
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and audio evidence, heard from the driver of car 4 (Lando Norris) and a team representative. It was explained that the team instructed the driver to conduct a "bite point find" in the Pit Lane. This procedure normally involves the slowing, but not the stopping, of the car. However, in this case the driver accidentally stalled the car, the anti-stall activated and the car moved again after 0.7 of a second. Accordingly, although technically this was not in accord with the instructions in the Race Director's Notes (Document 2 item 7.2) the Stewards decide that no penalty shall be imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 4 Stopping In The Pit Lane
